body.p: Fred Leise is an information architect consultant and freelance indexer. He has been indexing since 1995, specializing in scholarly works in the humanities. Fred also develops indexing software and has presented at numerous professional conferences on information architecture and indexing topics.

Kate Mertes is a sole proprietor of editorial and indexing services. She holds a Ph.D. in medieval history and served as president of the American Society of Indexers from 2002 to 2003. Kate has extensive experience in legal and scholarly publishing.

Nan Badgett is the owner of Word-a-bil-i-ty, a trade book indexing service. She has been indexing since 1991, with particular expertise in construction, sports, and crafts topics. Nan has experience with both dedicated indexing software and embedded indexing methods including FrameMaker and Microsoft Word.
